text:
Alex P: quick thought — prototype a tiny suite of release "microtools" to make common deploy ops composable and idempotent. not another giant workflow.
Maria G: love the idea. what would live in the suite?
Alex P: keep it small: 1) `release-sketch` (generate release notes skeleton), 2) `pin-toggle` (temp pin/unpin a service), 3) `freeze-window` (lightweight change-window guard), 4) `deploy-assist --dry-run`.
Jamal R: solid. must guarantee idempotency and include audit logs. `--dry-run` should be first-class.
Alex P: example usage: `/pin-toggle payments 2024.11 --dry-run`
deploy-bot: [INFO] dry-run: would pin `payments` -> `2024.11` for canary pool (no changes applied)
Jen (SRE): also suggest a `--auto-revert=30m` or `--swapback-on-fail` option that reverts if healthchecks fail.
Yoel (PM): for release notes, the sketch should include fields: consumer-impact, metrics to watch, and explicit rollback steps.
Maria G: can you paste a tiny template? YAML frontmatter would be handy for automation.
Alex P: snippet:
```yaml
release:
  version: "2024.11"
  services:
    - payments
change_window: "2024-07-15T02:00Z/2024-07-15T04:00Z"
notes:
  - "Add idempotent pin toggle to reduce rollout flakiness"
rollback:
  - "run /pin-toggle payments previous-version"
  - "monitor 5m; if error rate > 0.5% revert"
```
Jamal R: nice. Also propose `deploy-bot` quick-actions in the thread: [Dry-run] [Apply] [Rollback] so people can click instead of copy/paste.
Alex P: implementation sketch: a tiny CLI wrapper (bash/sh) that composes calls to the orchestrator + a short Go service that handles the audit + idempotency tokens. config stored in `infra/release-templates` repo.
Maria G: testing plan: unit tests for idempotency, integration in staging with canary traffic, and a smoke test that exercises `--auto-revert` behavior.
Jen (SRE): gate actual apply behind `change_window` + realtime SLO check. if SLO violated during rollout then auto-revert and notify channel.
Yoel (PM): could we auto-populate changelog bullets from PR titles with a human-edit step in the sketch? helps surface consumer-facing language.
Alex P: yep — `release-sketch` will pull merged PRs since last tag and prefill bullets. folks edit before publish.
Maria G: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: created task T-4582: deploy-microtools RFC draft
Jen (SRE): schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 to walk the RFC and acceptance criteria.
Alex P: thanks — i'll open the PR with the CLI, template, and a sample staging job. tagging @Maria G @Jamal R for early review.
Maria G: i'll review after lunch.
Jamal R: i'll check the idempotency logic and the audit events.
Alex P: cool — will post links when PR/Ticket are up.
